name: slack
description: Interact with a Slack workspace through the official Slack MCP server — list channels and users, post and reply to messages, react with emoji, and read channel or thread history, all scoped to a single bot user.

interface.shortDescription: Read and write a Slack workspace through the official Slack MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Your agent can interact with your Slack workspace — reading channels, sending messages, replying in threads, reacting with emoji, and looking up users. No more switching tabs to Slack for quick updates. Just ask your agent what's happening in a channel, send a message to your team, or check recent activity. Everything happens through conversation, scoped to your workspace.
defaultPrompt: Check what's new in the team's Slack channels.
Send a message to the [channel name] channel for me.
Find a user and show me their profile information.
